findings.claim: Section 232 鋼鐵關稅 2025 年無豁免全面恢復並擴及約 600 項加工鋼製品；2025 年成品碳鋼與合金鋼進口較 2024 年減 17.4%，約占美國需求 18%；公司表示關稅未來可能被修改或終止。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, vigorous enforcement of U.S. trade remedy laws and the full reinstatement of the Section 232 steel tariffs without exemptions or exclusions resulted in a lower volume of steel 9 imports compared to 2024. Imports of finished carbon and alloy steel products decreased 17.4% from 2024, supplying approximately 18% of U.S. demand in 2025.

findings.claim: 風險因子：若 Section 232 等進口關稅到期、放寬或廢止，大量外國鋼材進口可能對美國鋼價形成下行壓力。
findings.excerpt: There can be no assurance as to when or if the Section 232 or other import tariffs, quotas or other duties may be enacted, enforced, extended, modified or terminated in the future.

findings.claim: Q2 2026 法說會：管理層稱成品鋼進口年減 25%，歸因於強化的 232 計畫與反傾銷／反補貼稅；並呼籲 USMCA 續約要求鋼材於北美熔煉澆鑄。
findings.excerpt: finished steel imports are down 25% year-over-year due to the strengthening of the 232 program, along with antidumping and countervailing duties on corrosion-resistant steel and other steel products.

note: 出口管制／實體清單未另搜尋到相關來源；USMCA 續約不確定性見 Q2 call 摘要。
